//TR: Bu dosya A-Z 26 üretim hattının canonical, makine-okunur kaydıdır: sahiplik (oturum), görev türleri, izinli yollar, hat bağımlılıkları ve hat/küresel kota. Mevcut dispatcher (docs/planning/dispatch.mjs --plan / --lane) bu kaydı docs/planning/lanes.mjs ile fail-closed doğrular ve BACKLOG_CHECKPOINT.json görevlerini buna göre yönlendirir; ikinci bir orkestratör yoktur.
basis: Founder directive 2026-10-22 (A-Z Production Lane Registry and Working Dispatcher). Lanes A, B and C keep their 2026-10-21 owners and paths; Z is the coordinator; D-Y are STANDBY until a builder session is assigned.

capacity.basis: builderCap 4 = the four running sessions (Lanes A, B, C and the coordinator). ciSlots 6 stays below the 8 concurrent PR CI runs observed congesting the Windows runner queue on 2026-10-22.

routing: A task's lane is the lane whose allowedPaths entry is the longest match for every owned file; files under sharedPaths do not decide the lane when other files exist.
An entry ending in '/' or '-' is a prefix; any other entry is an exact file. Matching ignores case (Windows checkouts).
Files owned by two lanes => CROSS_LANE (split the task). A protected or CI-executed file => never routed.
A task without files is routed by type, then by package prefix, and runs one at a time within its lane.
Tasks of upstream lanes (dependsOnLanes) are planned first; two tasks whose files overlap never run in the same wave.
Wave 0 holds what may start now under each lane's maxActive/maxOpenPrs, builderCap and ciSlots, counting work already in flight.
